meta.title: Campus — 25s polished silent demo
meta.description: Silent, no voiceover. Burned-in pills, auto-zoom on action zones, mocked SSE with tool chips. Reproducible via nix-shell.

chapters.action: Load Today, subtle scroll 120px to reveal Next 7 days strip. Cursor rests center.
chapters.caption: Brightspace is scattered. Campus syncs it offline.

chapters.action: Glide cursor to sync badge (✓ 21 tables · sha256), hover tooltip Last sync 2m ago · 3 files changed pops.
chapters.caption: Offline-first: D2L REST + Playwright MFA → SQLite.

chapters.action: Snap cut to Course hub. Click Modules ▸ Week 4 · Paging, tree expands. Click Lecture 4 — Paging.pdf, preview appears.
chapters.caption: Every course, browsable — not a file dump.

chapters.action: Drag zoom slider to 125%, pageless reflow animates, click Open in Zen Markdown.
chapters.caption: Pageless PDF + zen markdown for actual study.

chapters.action: Glide to left nav Chat, click, 180ms slide to Chat view. Course pill CS 1100A already selected.
chapters.caption: Course-scoped chat. Cited, not hallucinated.

chapters.action: Type 'How did the Aug 19 lecture define thrashing? And move my review to Aug 31.' with jitter. Press Enter at 14.4s. Chips: search_corpus at 14.6s → ✓ 3 sources at 15.2s, mutate at 15.6s → ✓ Aug 31 at 16.2s.
chapters.caption: Ask anything — watch the tools work.

chapters.action: Mocked SSE streams tokens (18ms/token). Citation [Lecture 4 p.12] fades in. Audit card slides up: before 2025-08-19 → after 2025-08-31 · sha256.
chapters.caption: Cited answer. Audited mutation. Blind-graded quiz ready.

chapters.action: Ease zoom to 1.0 over 400ms, crossfade finale card over bottom 28%: left stack pills Python · Playwright · FastAPI · SQLite · Docker · PWA, right CTA github.com/HasNate618/Campus + Installable · Works offline badge.
chapters.caption: Offline-first. Installable. Ships with Docker + CI.
